title: The buddy's buttons — round three: Open, Hide, and evening out the row

steps.path: The button row beside the buddy, third button
steps.headline: Which mix of "App window" and "Window, arrow out" says "open YouCoded" best?
steps.notice: All three keep the app window and send the arrow out through its top corner. Every row here already uses the evened-out sizes from I-6.

variants.label: Window with dots
variants.summary: The window's title bar and its two little dots, with the arrow leaving through the open corner.

variants.label: Window, no dots
variants.summary: The same, without the dots: simpler, a little calmer at small size.

variants.label: Smaller arrow
variants.summary: Dots kept, the arrow shorter so the window itself is the bigger part.
variants.risk: At real size the arrow is easier to miss.

steps.path: The button row beside the buddy, last button
steps.headline: Which cleaned-up eye should Hide use?
steps.notice: The eye is redrawn as one smooth shape, and the slash now cuts a clean gap through it instead of crossing over the pupil.

variants.label: Crossed eye, ring pupil
variants.summary: The familiar "hide" eye, tidied: smooth outline, round pupil, a clean gap where the slash passes.

variants.label: Crossed eye, solid pupil
variants.summary: The same with a filled pupil, which reads as an eye a little faster at small size.

variants.label: Closed eye
variants.summary: A sleeping eye with lashes, no slash: friendlier, like he is resting.
variants.risk: Less common as a "hide" picture, so the label does more of the work.

steps.headline: Should all four buttons be redrawn to one even size?
steps.notice: Before, each picture filled a different amount of its button and sat at a slightly different height, which is the zig-zag you saw. Evened out, all four fill the same height and share one middle line. The resize arrows are pulled in slightly too.

variants.label: As before
variants.summary: Round two's pictures at their old sizes.

variants.label: Evened out
variants.summary: Same height, same middle line for all four.
